title: Unify Window Panes Into A Shared 8-Anchor Draggable Pane API
description: Window panes (measures, engagement/actions, search, utility bar, controls) are inconsistent in sizing, positioning, and UI element usage across apps. Build one shared Pane API/mechanism (extending the existing 6-anchor Panel dock to 8 anchors: 4 corners + 4 edge middles), whole-pane draggable between any anchor, with a clearance model so opposite-anchored panes never overlap. Migrate the shell Window's 5 bespoke overlay slots plus cad's bespoke asides and infinite's hardcoded floating chrome onto it. Concretely fixes: puzzle 3d's Werkzeug/Füllen options tree overlapping the top ribbons (bottom-anchored tree had no clearance/scroll bound) — the tree must grow upward to just below the top panes, show everything, and scroll internally beyond that.
summary:
Extended the shared panel anchor model from 6 to 8 anchors (4 corners + 4 edge middles) across TS (ui/js/react, framework/renderer/react, framework/core/js) and the Rust wgpu mirror, renaming `PanelAnchor`/`PANEL_ANCHORS` to `Anchor`/`ANCHORS`. Built a new, tested `Pane`/`PaneHost`/`usePaneSlot`/`nearestAnchor` API in ui/js/react/index.tsx — window-level floating chrome that shares the exact same `anchorPositionStyle`/`flowFromAnchor` positioning math as the shell's `Panel` dock, is foldable, resizable, and (given `onAnchorChange`) draggable by a handle to any of the 8 anchors, snapping via a 3x3 zone test. Bumped `DockSkeleton`/`DockUiState` to version 3 (stale blobs self-discard, no migration) and added a new `WindowPaneStateStore` persistence class mirroring `DockUiStateStore`, ready for future pane-position persistence.

Root-caused and fixed the concrete Füllen/utility-bar overlap bug: the bottom-anchored `utility-bar-overlay`'s `max-h-full` never reliably bounded its content (percentage max-height against a box whose own height is itself only ever set via `max-height`, never an explicit `height`, doesn't reliably resolve, and no `min-h-0`/scroll boundary existed on the actual content row). Added `useWindowUtilityBarMaxHeightPx`, a ResizeObserver-driven hook mirroring the existing `useWindowMeasuresReservePx` pattern, reusing `measureWindowChromeScrollClearancePx` (the top-chrome clearance already computed for scroll-padding) as a hard pixel cap applied via inline style directly on `utility-bar-body`, with `overflow-y-auto` added to `utilityBarBodyClass`. The active-utility options tree (e.g. puzzle 3D's Füllen tree) now grows upward only to just below the top-anchored panes and scrolls internally beyond that — verified by a new regression test and a clean typecheck; live browser confirmation in puzzle-3d-react-dev was attempted but blocked by unrelated shared-environment cargo contention (see ticket notes).

Migrated `WorldOrbitProjectionSwitch` (infinite/world/r3f) off its hardcoded `absolute bottom-[4.75rem] right-3` position into a pure chrome surface, and wired both its consumers (framework/renderer/react's World3dHost, cad/renderer/js's InteractionRepl play overlay) through `usePaneSlot` into a `PaneHost` now mounted inside every `Window`'s body — it's draggable to any of the 8 anchors with local component state. Deferred (not started): the full migration of the shell `Window`'s five bespoke overlay slots (measures/engagement/search/utility-bar/controls) onto the new `Pane` component itself, cad's large REPL `<aside>` sidebar-to-floating-pane conversion, and Storybook stories for `Pane` — all scoped out as separate, well-bounded follow-ups given the size/regression-risk of rewriting Window's deeply-tested existing fold/expand/key-routing behavior versus the value of shipping the anchor model, the Pane mechanism, and the concrete bug fix now.

Verification: full-repo `tsc --noEmit` shows zero new errors across every touched file (several files improved vs. the pre-existing baseline). Targeted vitest runs: 7/7 new Pane-API + clearance tests pass (ui/js/react), 48/48 framework-core persistence tests pass (incl. new WindowPaneStateStore + dock v3 discard-on-mismatch tests), 27/27 framework-renderer-react dock/panel tests pass. Rust: exhaustive match-arm review of the 8-variant `PanelAnchor` enum in framework/renderer/wgpu/rs/lib.rs (all match sites updated and verified exhaustive by inspection); the workspace's puzzle-plugin crate (which depends on framework/core/rs's `PanelGroup::anchor()`, one of the two edited Rust files) compiled successfully during an earlier pass of the same build.
